# Poses debout — ImageGen intégré

Référence d’identité : `art/04-personnages-originaux.png` à la racine du projet. Fichier : `cast-idle.png`, neuf lignes de quatre directions.

```text
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a functional IDLE ANIMATION ATLAS for an actual 2D top-down school RPG. Portrait canvas, exactly FOUR COLUMNS by NINE ROWS, 36 isolated full-body sprites total, equal regular cells with ample transparent margins, no labels, no frame borders. ONE character per ROW, FOUR standing directions per row. COLUMN 1 faces DOWN toward viewer, COLUMN 2 faces LEFT, COLUMN 3 faces RIGHT, COLUMN 4 faces UP away. ALL characters STANDING STILL, BOTH FEET evenly grounded at the same height, relaxed symmetrical arms down, absolutely no walking or running pose. Orthographic slightly overhead JRPG camera, top of head visible, fine colored pixel art, 3-head-tall sprites, consistent size and pixel density across all36. Sharp pixel clusters, fine hair strands, shaded burgundy blazer, delicate gold trim, navy bottoms, ivory shirt, black loafers. Background genuinely transparent RGBA, no backdrop, no floor, no shadow, no glow, no text anywhere. Keep every sprite fully inside its own cell and preserve the same character identity through the four directions.
Attached image is identity reference for Reina, Nao, Mika, Daichi ONLY.
ROW 1: PLAYER boy, layered medium-brown hair, amber eyes, navy tie and trousers.
ROW 2: REINA girl, short dark-brown bob, grey eyes, navy ribbon and pleated knee-length skirt, dark socks.
ROW 3: NAO boy, tousled black hair, hazel eyes, navy tie and trousers.
ROW 4: MIKA girl, auburn hair in low side ponytail, amber eyes, navy ribbon and pleated knee-length skirt, dark socks.
ROW 5: DAICHI athletic boy, cropped brown hair, brown eyes, navy tie and trousers.
ROW 6: SORA boy, precise side-part charcoal hair, small rectangular glasses, navy tie and trousers.
ROW 7: YUI girl, shoulder-length honey-brown hair, cream hairclip, navy ribbon and pleated knee-length skirt, dark socks.
ROW 8: REN boy, swept-back violet-black hair, composed expression, small gold lapel pin, navy tie and trousers.
ROW 9: HAYASE adult woman teacher about32, charcoal low bun, glasses, tailored NAVY jacket and trousers (not burgundy uniform), ivory blouse and burgundy neck scarf, black practical shoes.
This is a single tall 4x9 SPRITE GRID, not a character illustration. Exactly 36 sprites, nine rows, four columns. Avoid raised knees, staggered feet, weapons, large props or duplicate characters in different rows.
```
